acceptance.text: Classify all five authentication requirements and eight wire-format requirements with a reason for each. Interpret each coherent vocabulary once. Remove the replaced per-row runners while preserving their devnet outcomes, receipt-derived states and recorded gaps. Report the runner size before and after, the unchanged model revision and the limits of the verification.

limits.text: Lean remains the behavioral authority. This migration changes no model and does not wire the separate authentication specification. The wrong-constructor requirement remains unmet by ruling, and partial constructor coverage stays partial. Newly executed rows or newly exposed model gaps need a ruling before acceptance. No task is complete without its checkpoint review and required evidence.
